data.content_ref: inline:Artifact 0ba8f16f5116 shares mechanism with SRC_008 and SRC_009: all three invoke a lap-count or positional-increment misframing that severs the link between physical passing and ordinal rank, producing 'third' from the false premise that the overtaken runner's label acts as a floor rather than a transferable position. The shared mechanism is ordinal decoupling — the claim that physical order and ordinal placement can diverge. This is refuted if the race is single-lap with real-time position tracking such that physical order always equals ordinal placement, or if overtaking is defined as assuming the overtaken runner's exact rank.
